ios.desc:
BetterNews puts a live voice room on every story.

See which stories people are talking about right now, tap one that's on air, and you're in the room, listening and talking with other readers. Use push-to-talk or an open mic. Your room keeps going while you read the thread, scroll the feed or lock your phone.

FEATURES
• A live voice room on every story, with live counts in the feed
• Push-to-talk or open mic
• Full comment threads
• On iPad, the feed and the room side by side
• Bookmarks, saved on your device
• Light and dark mode

SAFETY
• Everyone agrees to the community rules before talking
• Mute, block or report anyone in a room
• Reported accounts are reviewed and can be banned
• Delete your data at any time from your profile

Stories and comments come from Hacker News. BetterNews is an independent app and is not affiliated with Y Combinator or Hacker News.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I have published a mobile HN client to have coffee chat with HN users

quotes.text:
Hi, I have published a mobile app to have coffee chat with HN users.

There was already a guy who made a website for this, but I wanted to do it in mobile to practice WebRTC(technology behind the audio chat) and have some fun.

I haven't spent too much time in terms of the general functionality as a HN client but can upgrade it if there are enough users enjoying the app.

You can download the apps via the links below;

IOS: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/betternews-coffee-chat/id6504711182

Android:

As you might have known, Android requires the app to be tested in a closed beta with at least 20 people So you can follow these steps to be a part of it and download;

1 - join the group https://groups.google.com/g/betternews

2 - download the app and enjoy

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apps.betternews or https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.apps.betternews

Feel free to contact me if you have any questions; http://www.x.com/canergly
